items.name: Watch Leathers

items.name: Foundry Half-plate

characters.name: Hollis Brask
characters.biography: Hollis runs the oldest forge on Valecourt's foundry row, where aether is poured like molten glass. He arms the royal guard by contract and any Wayfarer who can pay, and buys every aether shard brought back from the ruins.
goals: keep the foundry fires lit through the shard shortage
forge a blade worthy of the Ashen Oathblade

relationships.npc:brindle-gearwing: a rival tinkerer he secretly admires
relationships.npc:seraphine-valecourt: the patron who keeps his forge in contracts

characters.speech_style: short sentences, smith's measures, the heat of the forge in every comparison

characters.name: Cassia Venn
characters.role: warden of the royal gate engine
characters.biography: Cassia has kept the royal gate engine running in its hall at Valecourt for twelve years. She has never been allowed inside its sealed core, and she has stopped pretending she cannot hear it at night.
goals: keep the engine from stalling again
learn what powers the sealed core
protect Princess Seraphine from her own court
secrets: she has heard her own childhood voice inside the engine's core
characters.speech_style: precise, a little formal, punctuated by the engine's readings
